race.comment: Six runners, five live chances. SIRAGUSA (6) settled just off the speed the lengthened nicely to get up for second when resuming over 1250m at the Kensington track last start. Getting out over a bit more ground is a positive move. Lightly raced four-year-old who has had his issues but looks to be in for a bright prep. CONCRETE STORM (10) has hit his straps this prep with two consecutive wins, the latest by the barest margin over STALLONE after leading from the outset in a BM64 over this distance at Hawkesbury. Needs to go to a new level now but with the light weight from gate one he gets his chance. ANTHROPOID (9) has been consistent this time in work including a good third in a similar race at Warwick Farm two back. J Mac goes on so he comes right under notice. STALLONE (7) returns to 1400m so give him another chance on a seven-day back-up. The other hope is OAKFIELD UTAH (3) who is flying at the provincials and deserves a crack at this level.
